ValidationRule.description: Neither CEO or HOB can update the case unless some fields under Compliance are available
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( RecordType_DeveloperName__c='Compliance_Query', NOT(ISNEW()), TEXT(Type)='Compliance', $UserRole.Name = 'Head of Business', OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Origin_of_Alert__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Speculated_FCC_Risk_Type__c)) ), OR(ISCHANGED(Head_of_Business_Results__c), ISCHANGED( cc_CEO_Result__c ))
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Origin of Alert, Speculated FCC Risk Type and Compliance Results are required to be filled by Compliance team post validating.
